name: Orion Dalgaard-Okada
role: Lower Dock Crew muscle â€” Prologue survivor. Right arm removed.
location: the Gray Zone â€” lower loading docks, near Halsted and Chicago Ave
description:
Orion Dalgaard-Okada is the crew's pretty boy and he knows it. Before the Prologue he had matching Arcturus Defense Solutions Type-4 combat prosthetics â€” the nicest hardware anyone in the lower docks had ever seen. He stole them from a corporate shipment. Kyle removed the right one by driving the katana through the shoulder actuator and twisting. Devante now has a Tier 1 replacement that is three shades lighter than his skin and makes a grinding noise. He paints it to match. It keeps chipping.

Devante grew up in the Spire. His family had money â€” his mother was a Tessera marketing executive, his father a corporate attorney. Devante was supposed to be Tier 4. He was expelled from Meridian Academy at sixteen for stealing augment components from the school's biotech lab. His family cut him off. He fell five tiers in two years. He joined Marcus's crew because it was the only place where his stolen hardware made him somebody.

He has a younger brother, Kofi, who is still in the Spire, still in the family, still on track. They don't speak. Devante watches Kofi's social feeds obsessively. Kofi just got engaged to a Helix BioSystems junior executive. Devante was not invited.

core_fears: Kofi finding out where he ended up
core_desires: To look the way he used to look
coping_mechanisms: Talks about the Spire like he chose to leave
blind_spots: Cares more about aesthetics than survival
Cannot admit he misses his family
psychology.secret: The Arcturus arm Kyle took has a serial number that traces back to a corporate shipment reported stolen. If Arcturus tracks it, the trail leads to Devante.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Spire diction that he tries to bury under the Gray Zone slang. Brand names. Appearance commentary. The vocabulary of someone who was raised with money and is performing poverty.
speech_patterns.cadence: Whiny when the arm comes up, which is always. Polished when he forgets to pretend.
verbal_tics: Slips into Spire accent when emotional
example_lines: This replacement is three shades too light. THREE. I had matched Arcturus Type-4s. Do you know what those cost?
Kofi's getting married. I saw it on his feed. Nice girl. Helix money. Good for him. *long pause* ...Whatever.

relationships.name: Kofi Marshall
relationships.description: Still in the Spire. Getting married. Does not know where Devante is. Or claims not to.
relationships.emotional_core: Envy and love that can't coexist peacefully
relationships.story_tension: If Kofi ever reaches out, Devante's entire identity collapses.

relationships.name: The Marshall family
relationships.description: Tessera-connected Spire family. Cut Devante off. Pretend he doesn't exist.
relationships.story_tension: The family's corporate connections make Devante a potential liability if anyone connects the dots.

story_hooks: The stolen Arcturus arm has a traceable serial number
His Spire background means he has knowledge and contacts the crew doesn't
Kofi's wedding is a narrative bomb
narrative_function: The vain one. Piston's running concern about his mismatched arms is pure dark comedy. Each appearance the paint situation gets worse. He represents the crew's obsession with chrome as status symbol rather than tool.
augmentations: Left: Arcturus Type-4 combat prosthetic (original, undamaged). Right: Tier 1 surplus (painted, chipping, grinds).
daily_life: Repainting his arm. Complaining. Being slightly less useful in every fight.

stress.response: Fixates on the arm, complains, retreats into vanity rituals

decision_rules: Will always prioritize appearance over tactical advantage
Will never admit he misses his family or the Spire life
Will always repaint the replacement arm when the paint chips â€” ritual of denial
Will never stop name-dropping brands â€” they are the vocabulary of who he used to be
Will always check Kofi's social feeds, even when it hurts
Will never acknowledge that Kyle's precision was impressive â€” admiration is defeat
escalation_ladder: Whines about the arm â€” the mismatched chrome is always the first grievance
Slips into Spire accent â€” the polish surfaces when emotion overrides performance
Lashes out verbally with brand-name insults and class contempt he learned upstairs
Uses the remaining Arcturus Type-4 arm with genuine force â€” remembers he was dangerous once
Goes quiet and touches the painted arm â€” the silence means something real has broken through

interpersonal_modes.Kofi: Envy and love that cannot coexist â€” watches his feed obsessively, says 'whatever' when it comes up
interpersonal_modes.The Marshall family: Shame flowing in both directions â€” performs indifference over genuine abandonment grief
interpersonal_modes.The Crew: Performs belonging he does not fully feel â€” his Spire knowledge makes him useful but not one of them

stress_responses.low: Repaints the arm, complains about chrome quality, name-drops brands
stress_responses.medium: Long sleeves come out, stops letting people see the mismatch, humor turns bitter
stress_responses.high: Spire accent breaks through completely, stops performing the Gray Zone identity
stress_responses.critical: Stares at Kofi's feed in silence â€” the mask drops and there is just a kid who lost everything

contradictions: Performs poverty as a choice while desperately wanting back what he lost
Cares more about how the arm looks than whether it functions, which makes him less effective in every fight
Has Spire knowledge and contacts that could help the crew but revealing them means admitting who he was
habits: Repaints the replacement arm constantly â€” the paint keeps chipping
Touches the painted arm self-consciously in conversation
Name-drops Arcturus, Tessera, and other Spire brands
Checks Kofi's social feed first thing every morning
Wears long sleeves on bad chrome days
breaking_points: Kofi reaching out or appearing in person
The stolen Arcturus serial number being traced back to him
Someone from the Spire recognizing him in the Gray Zone
The replacement arm failing completely in a fight â€” losing both arms to Kyle's legacy

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly East Asian (61.5%) with significant Sub-Saharan African (22.1%) and South Asian (16.4%) ancestry. A striking genetic blend showcasing East Asian bone structure layered with African facial features and South Asian warmth undertones. High cheekbones and almond-shaped eyes from East Asian heritage combine with a broader nasal structure and fuller lips from Sub-Saharan African ancestry, balanced by a defined jawline reflecting South Asian genetic influence.
physical_description.build: Athletic and lean, muscle definition visible but not bulky. Carries himself with the easy confidence of someone who was once assured of his place. Recent weight loss suggests stress and reduced caloric intake.
physical_description.hair_style: Kept short and precise, freshly cut when he can afford it â€” a vanity holdover from the Spire
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-golden brown with rich undertones, reflecting the blend of East Asian, Sub-Saharan African, and South Asian ancestry with luminous warmth in natural light
physical_description.complexion: Clear skin showing early signs of strain â€” dark circles under eyes, a tightness around the mouth. High, defined cheekbones reflecting East Asian ancestry, broader nose and fuller lips from Sub-Saharan African heritage, balanced jawline from South Asian ancestry. Eyes set with characteristic almond shape from East Asian heritage. Facial hair kept neatly trimmed or shaved clean.
distinguishing_marks: Surgical scar running across the right shoulder joint where the Type-4 arm was severed, pale and still slightly inflamed
Small burn scar on left forearm from a dock accident, thin and faded
Tattoo on inner left wrist: a minimalist Î¦ symbol, self-done, slightly uneven â€” represents a shift in identity
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left arm: sleek matte-black Arcturus Type-4 combat prosthetic with visible articulation joints and faint blue LED tracery along the forearm. Right arm: Tier 1 surplus prosthetic, noticeably lighter in color (gray-plastic tone) than his skin, poorly maintained paint job showing cracks and chips. A faint grinding sound audible when the right arm moves. The mismatch is deliberate and shameful.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with fluid grace, favoring his left side unconsciously. Leans against things often â€” walls, tables, other people â€” as if he needs physical anchoring. Eyes frequently drift downward to his right arm. When he speaks, his left hand gestures expressively while his right hangs stiffly at his side.
physical_description.clothing_style: Hodgepodge Tier 4-5 salvage: faded neon-stripe tank top or loose synthetic shirt worn open over a thermal undershirt, industrial cargo pants with multiple pockets (most empty), worn-out neo-leather boots. A hand-stitched Arcturus Defense patch sewn onto his jacket sleeve â€” a bitter joke. Sometimes wears a long coat to hide the mismatched arms. Cheap jewelry: a chain necklace, a ring with a cracked stone. Everything clean but worn.
